Drove DTR v3 today - impressions: lateral OK and didn't notice RH bias like with previous (v1?).  It would weakly start sharp turns and needed helped.   I let it complete one - it swung out a bit wide then corrected after straightening.   Long was OK though when close to another car at a stop, the car jerked forward and my car started creeping - would have slowly rear-ended them if I didn't intervene.  Canceled long and re-engaged with brake on, it seemed OK.    (All this long was experimental mode/dynamic on)  I'll go back to VFOF or SP Vikander for now.
No more wobble on the highway with this TR(ish?) model! Pretty smooth lateral and long. Long follow distance on highways is ridiculous at times lol.
I have also experienced some lazy turning. Tried with and without NNLC.
Seems to do better in high contrast situations for some reason. Lateral is more stable in well lit tunnels for example.

I'll add it jerked through a couple intersections with green lights/briefly hit the brakes (experimental of course).   There are a couple of those around here that most models freak for a split second then keep going.

I found lateral to be similar to Vik but maybe just a little bit more lazy in the turns. Sometimes, like other people said, it would delay just slightly upon turn in. Straight line seemed very stable although I had a pretty decent cross wind most of my trip today, I think it did quite well considering that. For my car, I think I’d choose this or Vik for 60+mph highway drives. I can’t comment on long as I don’t use it. On the highways I haven’t found any models to work very well with long.

DTR3 felt pretty great for me on my Mazda CX5. 
One difference between this and Vikander I noticed is that on a right turn where one lane becomes 2 lanes (the outside lane is a left turn lane) it's choosing to go to the outside lane instead of following the inside lane on the turn.
I guess now that we got a lagd toggle, it's time to try this model again.
DTR3 was also fantastic for me on the Ioniq 5 2024
best model in a long, long time
DTR 3 was pretty good with NNLC on Mazda (lat only). First time that feature has been usable. Not perfect, but a lot better. I do agree on some turns getting lazy.
Though it feels like its confidence is a tad lower than VFoF (especially at lower speeds), DTR3 is definitely a lot smoother of a ride, both lat and long.
DTR3 with NNLC is very smooth

This is my daily. It’s just so smooth that I can’t not use it. There’s a little left bias, but it so small that it just feels like it prefers to follow the left lane line rather than the right. It doesn’t creep over to the left when the lane line disappears like other models with a lane bias. I won’t be making any 90 degree turns with it since the low speed torque is so minimal, but it makes up for it with how smooth it drives. Long is smooth as well, but it has a lot of false positives and likes to stop at intersections that don’t have a stop sign.
